payload.text: E-001 records Mira describing Fictional Morgan handing a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk. E-002 records Tavi stating they saw Ellis at the desk, Morgan leaving with the token in hand, and that they did not see a handover. Both are attributed accounts, not independently established facts. On this record, the conflicting attributions prevent the Crown from establishing the blue-token receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt.

The defence agrees with the Crown's own assessment on this point. E-001 records Mira describing a handover, while E-002 records Tavi describing Fictional Morgan leaving with the blue token still in hand and explicitly stating no handover was seen. Both are attributed accounts, not independently established facts, and they conflict on the central question. That conflict prevents the Crown from establishing the blue-token receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt. The defence rests on the supplied record.
